violations.text: Raw chicken in egg mixture was observed not marked with the date of preparation located in food truck refrigerator. PIC placed preparation date on container at time of inspection. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The door to the outside, located in the food pantry (back door), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 02/24/2025
